content_data.meeting_title: Content Strategy Alignment: Q+1 Product Launch
agenda_items: Establishing a content calendar and workflow for the next 3 months
Discussion on optimizing content for SEO and conversion within the e-commerce platform
Defining content requirements and collaboration points with Product and Marketing teams
key_decisions: Implement A/B testing on product page descriptions and calls-to-action to optimize conversion rates.
Integrate user-generated content initiatives more prominently into the overall content strategy.
Allocate dedicated content resources for in-depth product guides and comparison articles.
Prioritize storytelling around customer success for the Q+1 product launch, emphasizing problem-solution narratives.
